newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves with weekend system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves with weekend system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system Friday via a round of weekend system repurchase agreements (RP), economists said.

Thursday the Fed stayed out of the banking system, an indication its add need was not as high as some analysts thought. However, a weekend system operation was seen as needed to handle reserve needs through Monday.
Fed funds were trading at 5-1/8 percent, slightly below the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/4 percent.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663 ))
